latest_news.headline: UAE intercepts 20 missiles + 37 drones — cumulative 398 missiles, 1,872 drones since war began

latest_news.headline: Ukraine-Qatar defense deal signed — Zelensky Gulf drone diplomacy continues

latest_news.headline: Iran claims destruction of Ukrainian anti-drone depot in Dubai — Ukraine denies

latest_news.headline: Turkey reaffirms mediation role — FM Fidan-Araghchi call ahead of Islamabad talks

latest_news.headline: Tehran heavy strikes continue overnight — some residents fleeing north
latest_news.text: Another night of heavy strikes on Tehran. Power cuts in some areas. Mixed civilian reactions: some want war to continue 'until clerics gone,' others fleeing to northern Iran. Month-old conflict now entering normalization phase for some residents.
